BiblicalUsage: This branch belongs to the birds. In Psalm 104 the fowls of heaven have their habitation among the branches, where they sing, and the psalm turns the whole green world into a choir praising the Lord who provides for every living thing.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced the singing birds among the branches are a picture of the life God gives freely: He provides the tree, the nest, and the song.
